描述_EN: it would have been treasured by its owner, therefore buried with him when he died. in the tang dynasty (618-907) daily utensils were usually made of stoneware and goods for burial were made of earthenware. this lidded flask was an early example of white stoneware.
描述_ZN: 它应该是被它的主人所珍视的，因此在他死后与他一起埋葬。 在唐代（618-907），日常用具通常由石器制成，而埋葬物品则由陶器制成。 这个有盖酒壶是一个早期的白瓷器的例子。
